body: BLOCK exact c6587336e131a88a9b21d703532fdc6c037a2bd4 over parent 6ad95c5c5109aba3c282d854add422e67b71b07b. Integration finding in changed build.sbt: the candidate does not merely add providerParser; it deletes onnxRuntimeV and djlV, removes embedOnnx from root aggregation, deletes the complete embedOnnx project and its fork/ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY settings, removes embedOnnx from embedBench dependencies and removes embedBench fork/telemetry settings, and drops embedOnnx from jvmOnlyModules. The c658 tree still contains the complete embed-onnx sources, README, tests, model fixture, tokenizer, and goldens, so those bytes become orphaned and compileAll/testAll/testJVM no longer exercise an already-landed module. This also explains why the reported 15-task gate can pass: reference-scope derives modules from the candidate build and cannot name the project that this diff erased. Actionable repair: recut the current-main combination as an additive providerParser integration while preserving all embedOnnx pins, project/aggregate/gate membership, embedBench dependency, fork and telemetry settings from 6ad; then rerun reference-scope and the emitted gate. The previously approved exact-input result.scala delta and byte-identical 83-assertion reference-scope tools remain accepted; this BLOCK is solely the build integration regression. No authorization or landing claim.
